ModMetadata.Name: MisophoniaMod
ModMetadata.Author: aproposmath
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]MisophoniaMod[/h1] Mutes all drinking/eating related and/or other sounds, like pipe stress (configurable). Client only mod, no server installation required in multiplayer.
Installation: Subscribe the workshop item and make sure that BepInEx and StationeersLaunchpad are installed. See: https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad
Use the StationeersLaunchpad config tool or edit BepInEx/config/stationeers-misophonia-mod.config. Changes are applied when a save is loaded.
List of all configurable sounds: ActivateButton, ApcCharged, ApcCharging, ApcClose, ApcDischarged, ApcDischarging, ApcOff, ApcOn, ApcOpen, AtmosphereFire, AtmosphereFireStart, BobbleHead,
